description: Public Go localization corpus (docs/plans/bench-public.md PB-14..18, ADR-031): every ground truth is derived, never authored — the files and functions a developer's merged gold patch changed at a pinned base commit, and their static callers as computed by cmd/loctruth (go/types), from the pinned upstream snapshots listed in sources under the selection rule recorded in selection. Rebuild with `contextbenchscore import`; the result must reproduce corpus_sha256 bit-for-bit. The runner ingests each task's subject at base_commit into a scratch store under workspace/ (never the fleet store, never the post-fix tree). Criterion H2-2 is registered in machine_criterion before any run.

selection.statement: gold patch modifies or deletes 1–5 non-test Go source files present at base_commit; duplicates by (repo, base_commit, gold files) keep the source that sorts first; sort by instance_id; first 35

arms.name: fathom
arms.tools: fathom MCP companion surface only (read-only; ingest denied)

arms.name: none
arms.role: memorisation floor — a task this arm passes in >= leak_rule.min_passes of leak_rule.of_trials trials is leaked and excluded from the verdict

machine_criterion.description: fathom wins on the public corpus only if BOTH hold over the non-leaked tasks: (1) the seeded, task-clustered paired bootstrap 95% CI on the per-task success difference (fathom minus grep) excludes 0 in fathom's favour, on at least 30 non-leaked tasks — which entails strictly more successes; AND (2) fathom's aggregate tokens are <= 1.0x grep's. Success per cell is all-of over the fenced answer block within max_predicted; precision and recall are reported beside it. A task the none arm passes in >= 2 of 3 trials is leaked and excluded from the verdict, listed in the row. Any cell under 3 trials, or any task absent from an arm, makes the run indeterminate — never a win (ADR-027).

precision.reported: precision and recall per cell, beside pass/fail; never gating

reliability.primary: paired per-task success difference, fathom minus grep, task-clustered bootstrap CI
reliability.secondary: aggregate token ratio <= 1.0 (the median is reported for interpretation only)

omitted: find_callers Legacy: no non-test static callers
find_callers Runner.Exec: 9 callers exceeds the cap of 8

Put your final answer inside a single fenced code block, one entry per line and nothing else in the block; entries beyond the task's max_predicted are not scored.

An empty input must parse to -1, not 0.
